input.quote: 4.1 License Fees. In consideration for the licenses granted to Corio pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement, Corio shall pay the license fees specified in EXHIBIT B hereto. Payment terms of such license fees shall be as set forth in EXHIBIT B hereto.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee obligation payable by us (Corio, the licensee/customer). Section 4 and Exhibit B (Sections 17, Pricing and Revenue Sharing) impose only ordinary license, maintenance, MarketSite access, implementation and revenue-share fees, with no late-payment interest or penalty amounts (searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty" and "interest" returned no charging provisions). Section 11 provides for termination on notice or uncured material breach with no termination fee; the only surviving payment obligations are ongoing fees for continued use and support that we elect to receive. Section 9 caps liability at amounts actually paid by Corio and excludes indirect damages, and Section 4.4 audit costs are borne by Commerce One except for a limited reimbursement on a >5% underpayment, which is a cost-shifting term rather than liquidated damages. Consistent with the playbook's preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), no redline is required.
